scientific_integrity: Analytical proofs of general monotonicity criterion, rational power phase law, and Gaussian stationary maximum; supporting numerical checks are finite and not substituted for the proof. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Two symmetric real sites with equal unit self-weights and one bilateral update only. No general image-grid nonexpansivity is asserted. The global constants concern worst-case pair perturbations, not average noise suppression.
title: Sharp perturbation-stability transition for two-site bilateral smoothing
